Sectioned Beanie

Sizes: S (M, L)
Needles: 4 mm
Gauge: 22 sts and 30 rows = 10 cm in stockinette.

CO 80 (88, 96) sts.
Join to work in the round, being careful not to twist, and place a marker for the beginning of the round.
Rnd 1: *k2, p2; rep from * to end.
Repeat Rnd 1 until work measures 5 cm from cast-on edge.
Rnd 2: K to end.
Repeat Rnd 2 until piece measures 14 (15, 16) cm from cast-on edge.
Set-up rnd: *k10 (11, 12), pm; rep from * 6 more times, k10 (11, 12).
Dec rnd: *k to 2 sts before m, k2tog, sm; rep from * to end. — 72 (80, 88) sts
Knit rnd: K to end.
Repeat Dec rnd and Knit rnd until 40 sts remain.
Repeat Dec rnd until 16 sts remain.
Last rnd: K2tog to end. — 8 sts
Break yarn, draw the tail through the remaining stitches and pull tight.

Weave in ends and block.

Centre-Out Triangle Shawl

Needles: 4 mm
Gauge: 18 sts and 25 rows = 10 cm in garter-edged stockinette.

CO 5 sts.
Row 1 (RS): K2, yo, pm, k1, pm, yo, k2. [7 sts]
Row 2 (WS): K2, p to last 2 sts, k2.
Row 3 (RS): K2, yo, k to m, yo, sm, k1, sm, yo, k to last 2 sts, yo, k2. — 11 sts
Row 4 (WS): K2, p to last 2 sts, k2.
Repeat Rows 3 and 4 until there are 103 sts on the needle.
Edge row 1: K to end.
Repeat Edge row 1 3 more times.
BO all sts loosely.

Finishing: weave in all ends. Block to measurements.

Sectioned Beanie

Sizes: S (M, L)
Needles: 4 mm
Gauge: 21 sts and 28 rows = 10 cm in stockinette.

Cast on 80 (88, 96) stitches.
Join to work in the round, being careful not to twist, and place a marker for the beginning of the round.
Rnd 1: Repeat [knit 2, purl 2] to the end of the round.
Repeat Rnd 1 until piece measures 4 cm from cast-on edge.
Rnd 2: Knit to the end of the round.
Repeat Rnd 2 until piece measures 14 (15, 16) cm from cast-on edge.
Set-up rnd: Work [knit 10 (11, 12), place marker] 7 times, knit 10 (11, 12).
Dec rnd: Repeat [knit until 2 stitches before the marker, knit 2 together, slip marker] to the end of the round. [72 (80, 88) sts]
Knit rnd: Knit to the end of the round.
Repeat Dec rnd and Knit rnd until there are 40 sts on the needle.
Repeat Dec rnd until 16 sts remain.
Last rnd: Knit 2 together to the end of the round. [8 sts]
Break yarn, draw the tail through the remaining stitches and pull tight.

Finishing: weave in all ends. Block to measurements.

Centre-Out Triangle Shawl

Needles: 4 mm
Tension: 20 sts and 28 rows = 10 cm in garter-edged stocking stitch.

Cast on 5 sts.
Row 1 (RS): K2, yfwd, pm, k1, pm, yfwd, k2. — 7 sts
Row 2 (WS): K2, p to last 2 sts, k2.
Row 3 (RS): K2, yfwd, k to marker, yfwd, sm, k1, sm, yfwd, k to last 2 sts, yfwd, k2. [11 sts]
Row 4 (WS): K2, p to last 2 sts, k2.
Repeat Rows 3 and 4 until you have 147 sts.
Edge row 1: K to end.
Repeat Edge row 1 3 more times.
Cast off all sts loosely.

Finishing: weave in all ends. Block to measurements.
